program: SYM-01 - Primary Symbol / App-Icon Successor Divergence

F1.name: Split Field
F1.reason: Abstract, authored, topology remains legible across app/web roles and does not resolve primarily as a known software/category glyph. At 16-24px it is less distinctive than C0 and carries a paired-panel/quotation-like genericity reservation, but that reservation is not strong enough to falsify it.

F2.name: Continuous Fold
F2.reason: Reads primarily as a stair/stepped Z or process-like route glyph; this is direct forbidden-drift/generic software-symbol failure.

F3.name: Counterweighted Pair
F3.reason: At compact sizes the authored irregularity collapses into two generic dots/entities; its strongest reading is paired entities/people-like relation rather than a distinctive primary identity.

F4.name: Offset Aperture
F4.reason: Reads primarily as a cog/nut/settings-like convention because of the irregular outer field and circular aperture; familiar category-glyph reading dominates.

direct_incumbent_comparison.C0: Threshold K remains more distinctive and recoverable at 16-24px and carries stronger existing Kymaean identity continuity.
direct_incumbent_comparison.F1: F1 is a genuine non-Threshold-K challenger and therefore survives to Director taste input, but it does not displace C0 in Design Sol ranking.

design_sol_ranking: F1 - Split Field (sole challenger; alternate with compact-scale genericity reservation)
director_gate: Choose whether SYM-01 retains unchanged C0 Threshold K as provisional primary-symbol incumbent or advances exact frozen F1 Split Field instead. No F2/F3/F4 revival, redraw, hybrid, F5, or CLR-01 coupling is part of this choice.
